decisions.decision: The Committee agreed that collecting updated information from department heads is the most important next step in determining future municipal space requirements
decisions.quote: the committee agreed that collecting updated information from department heads is the most important next step in determining future municipal space requirements.

decisions.decision: The Committee's current focus should remain on determining departmental needs and space requirements rather than selecting a final site
decisions.quote: the chair emphasized that the committee's current focus should remain on determining departmental needs and space requirements rather than selecting a final site.

decisions.decision: The Committee reached consensus that its immediate priority is to complete the department head survey process, establish current and future space needs, determine departmental adjacencies and operational relationships, and develop preliminary square footage requirements
decisions.quote: the committee reached consensus that its immediate priority is to: • complete the department head survey process. • establish current and future space needs. • determine departmental adjacencies and operational relationships. • develop preliminary square footage requirements.

decisions.decision: The Committee agreed to meet again on June 15, 2026, with the expectation that survey results will be available for review and discussion
decisions.quote: the committee agreed to meet again on june 15, 2026, with the expectation that survey results will be available for review and discussion.

topics.resolution: Survey delayed but expected to be distributed immediately; responses anticipated prior to next meeting
topics.quote: david blatt reported that the department head survey had been delayed due to staff absences but was expected to be distributed immediately. responses are anticipated prior to the next meeting.

topics.topic: Discussion of Budget Climate and Community Sentiment
topics.resolution: Committee expressed caution about recommending costly studies or design efforts without clearer community support
topics.quote: committee members discussed the impact of the recent override vote and concerns regarding the community's willingness to support major capital projects.

topics.topic: Discussion of Turkey Hill School and Long-Term Planning
topics.resolution: Decisions regarding Turkey Hill should not delay current assessment of municipal space needs; coordination with school facility decisions important
topics.quote: committee members discussed whether the future of the turkey hill elementary school property could affect municipal building planning.

topics.topic: Focus on Needs Assessment and Space Planning
topics.resolution: Committee consensus on immediate priority: complete survey, establish space needs, determine adjacencies, develop square footage requirements
topics.quote: the committee also discussed the possibility that some municipal functions could potentially fit within the ritter memorial building with creative space planning and limited renovations, though updated survey data is needed before conclusions can be reached.
